title: 🔆🔅 Tehran, September 14 — Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks.
text:
🔆🔅 Tehran, September 14 — Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian made remarks."

"Source: Iran’s President’s Office"

""
"SOT1, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iranian President (Farsi) (00:05 - 00:19): "The sanctions that exist now are different from past ones; they have imposed war on us and they are increasing the sanctions day by day, and from the inside, they want to increase the divisions.”"

"SOT2, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iranian President (Farsi) (00:24 - 01:03): "The reality is that America is bullying, and many countries are intimidated by it—or well, I don't want to say whether they are afraid or not, they tell us privately, "Well, we are with you," but on the other hand, they don't dare to do what they need to do, meaning the reality of the matter is that it ultimately throws its weight around, those who claim to be champions of human rights and humanity—if you're telling the truth, what do you have to do with people's children, people's hospitals, people's infrastructure? You and I, what do you have to do with these? If you're a man, fight the people.”"

"SOT3, Masoud Pezeshkian, Iranian President (Farsi) (01:09 - 01:34): "With the technology and power they possess, the have created the terrorist government and assassinate whomever they wish, and, by the grace and power of Almighty God and through the solidarity and companionship we will have with you and all the people of Iran, we will solve our problems, [both] with our own neighbors and all [while] we will not bow down before them.”
